title: Tell Us What You Think: Loyalty Program Survey
paragraphs: Thank you for being a loyal reader of our newsletter. As part of our loyalty program, we would like to invite you to complete a short survey about your experience as a customer.

Your answers will give our research team valuable insight about what you enjoy most, and help measure overall satisfaction. Past surveys have shaped several changes, including an improved website and a faster checkout process.

As thanks for your time, everyone who completes the survey will be entered in a drawing for a 50 dollar gift card. Selected responses may also be shared as a testimonial on our website if we receive permission.

If you prefer not to receive future messages, you may unsubscribe at any time using the link below. Otherwise, we look forward to reading your feedback and continuing to share useful analytics for our readers.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of this message?
options: To invite the reader to complete a survey about their experience
To announce a price increase for the loyalty program
To apologize for a delayed newsletter
To advertise a new gift card product

questions.stem: What will everyone who completes the survey be entered into?
options: A free trial of the loyalty program

options: Reply to the email with a complaint
Wait for the survey to end

They were only sent to new customers
They led to real changes such as a redesigned website
